clips.title: The story
paras: Above Raven Hill Cemetery, Morbent Fel's wards keep him beyond ordinary steel. Sven Yorgen sends you with Morbent's Bane to break those wards and end the necromancer's terror in western Duskwood.

Morbent Fel haunts an abandoned house atop a rocky ridge just east of Sven's camp. The house looks over the sprawl of Raven Hill Cemetery. From there, the necromancer sends waves of undead through the surrounding forest and defiles Duskwood's graves. Dark magic and loyal undead thralls have kept ordinary steel from reaching him.

Morbent Fel's wards turn a direct assault into suicide, deflecting conventional attacks. Sven entrusts you with Morbent's Bane, an enchanted artifact made to unravel that magical shielding. Invoke the relic and the barrier collapses, leaving Fel open to a mortal strike.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Morbent Fel hides in his lair, the house perched atop the hill to the east overlooking the Raven Hill cemetery. His time in this land is drawing to an end...
Use Morbent's Bane against him. It will render his protective magics powerless.
Slay him. Slay him, and save us from his wickedness. Be the instrument of my revenge, and a hero of Duskwood!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Morbent Fel has been defeated. The dark riders are still at large, but a small piece of that which I had hoped beyond hope has come to pass.
You have done the impossible, and your deeds will forever live in the legends of Duskwood.
Go, friend. And perhaps, one day, fate may bring you back to me...
